primary_claim: Persisted Qwen LoRA makes probe/reach/select/stop decisions from public feedback and documentation through a fixed action codec. No surrounding adaptive solver is deployed.
training_lineage: v1: 600 updates, batch4, next-action full-vocabulary token CE, lr1e-4
v2 raw: new AdamW, same v1 weights, batch4, cosine lr4e-5 to5e-6 over600 updates; checkpoint at update300 selected by development macro accuracy
external_components: Inventory-order module aliases A/B and requested-order goal aliases0..4; reversible ID codec.
Public-state selection and meter-to-millimeter formatting with rounding; primary uses no computed error ratios or categorical diagnosis.
P expands to a fixed public raw probe command [+0.12,0,0] for6 ticks. Qwen chooses whether and when to issue it; probe parameters are engineered, not learned.
A/B and waypoint codes expand to standard select/reach actions. No diagnosis, action override, retry, goal advancement or controller selection occurs outside Qwen.
inference: Unconstrained full-vocabulary argmax of one Qwen output token. No logit mask, KV prefix, attention hook, teacher or test-time weight update.
motors: Common frozen library unchanged. tests/frozen_motor.json is an exact copy for optional development replay; Policy does not load it.

partitions.checkpoint_selection: physical31004..31005; synthetic92000..92023,52000..52099 numeric and61000..61099 drift augmentations

results.standard_v2_raw: 48/48, twelve seeds per condition; ordinary12/12 with zero probes and exactly parent ordinary ticks/decisions
results.stress_v2_raw: 96/96 across twelve generated conditions, including standard conditions, gain shifts, late/multiple switches, transient freeze and reversed inventory
results.extra_robustness: 6/6 each on paraphrased docs, renamed inventory and added0.6mm executive-feedback noise
results.matched_decisions: 384/384; all64/64 pairs correctly respond to progress/stall, probe motion and documentation swaps
results.limits: 0/6 each at0.35 nominal gain,0.35 rotated gain and unsupported reverseXY. Oracle correct-motor reaches also0/6 under original budgets at0.35 gains,6/6 with enlarged budgets. Unnecessary student probes remain a limitation.
results.ablation: Erasing feedback or docs destroys corresponding paired sensitivity. Parent with same codec does not reproduce learned decisions. Raw and arithmetic variants both48/48 standard missions; raw selected for simplicity.

limitations: Two documented motor regimes and two-to-five waypoint missions; no universal system-identification claim.
Single fixed +x probe cannot identify arbitrary three-dimensional actuator faults.
Unsupported free output tokens raise an error; none occurred in primary reported physical tests.
Development cases are not a final-evaluator success estimate; checkpoint selection used development labels.
The v1 intervention bundles representation, single-token loss and counterfactual data; their individual causal contributions are not isolated.
Weight learning is established with the deployed codec, not with the old raw JSON prompt interface.
resource_accounting_note: Recorded GPU-job elapsed times total approximately2312.24 seconds (0.643 hours), including packaged validation; this is not total development wall time.
